subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-21 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 英伟达遭SEC会计调查，AI股拖累美股回调；Anthropic称AI证明黎曼猜想
headline_en: Nvidia faces SEC accounting probe as AI selloff pushes S&P 500 and Dow into correction; Anthropic claims AI proof of Riemann hypothesis

items.title_zh: 英伟达遭SEC会计调查，股价延续2.5万亿美元跌势
items.title_en: Nvidia accounting under SEC investigation as $2.5 trillion rout deepens
items.body_zh: 据多家媒体报道，美国证券交易委员会正在调查英伟达的会计处理，消息人士称调查尚处早期。消息叠加AI板块抛售，英伟达股价继续下挫，市值蒸发规模已达约2.5万亿美元。
items.body_en: The SEC is reportedly investigating Nvidia's accounting, according to sources cited by multiple outlets, with the probe said to be at an early stage. The news added to an AI-sector selloff that has wiped roughly $2.5 trillion off Nvidia's market value.

items.title_zh: Anthropic称AI证明黎曼猜想，独立数学家初步认可
items.title_en: Anthropic says its AI proved the Riemann hypothesis; independent mathematicians weigh in
items.body_zh: Anthropic一名数学家称，他借助AI完成了对167年历史的黎曼猜想的证明，完整验证尚需时间。与此同时，一位人类数学家也宣称给出证明，《科学美国人》称独立数学家认为AI的证明「几乎可以肯定」成立。
items.body_en: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used AI to prove the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, though full verification will take time. A human mathematician has also claimed a proof, and Scientific American reports that independent mathematicians consider the AI proof 'almost certainly' correct.

items.title_zh: METR更新「时间跨度」曲线：AI编码进步快，判断类任务仍弱
items.title_en: METR updates its time-horizon graph: AI coding improves fast, judgment tasks lag
items.body_zh: AI评估非营利机构METR更新了其广受引用的「时间跨度」图表，发现部分AI能力仍沿指数轨迹提升。但报告同时指出，模型在需要判断力的任务上不如编码任务表现好。
items.body_en: The AI evaluation nonprofit METR has updated its widely cited time-horizon plot, finding that some AI capabilities continue to improve on an exponential trajectory. But the report also indicates models are less capable at tasks requiring judgment than at coding.

items.title_zh: 匿名模型Gestalt登顶设计榜，Elo超人类参考作品
items.title_en: Anonymous model Gestalt tops design benchmark, beating human reference
items.body_zh: Contra Labs的Frontier Design Benchmark盲测中，隐身开发状态的匿名模型Gestalt以Elo 1931分、90%胜率排名第一，超过Claude Fable 5.2和GPT-6.1 Sol。在设计师偏好评分中，它甚至高于人类设计师的参考作品。
items.body_en: In Contra Labs' blind Frontier Design Benchmark, the stealth anonymous model Gestalt ranked first with an Elo of 1,931 and a 90% win rate, beating Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.1 Sol. It even scored above the human-designer reference in preference ratings.

items.title_zh: 研究者植入200万个「金丝雀」追踪AI供应链，发现隐私灾难
items.title_en: Researcher plants 2 million canaries in AI supply chain, finds privacy disaster
items.body_zh: 一项用带唯一可追踪秘密的提示词进行的测试表明，用户数据在AI供应链中并未保持私密，泄露比例「令人警觉」。研究揭示了模型训练与推理链条上多个环节的数据外流风险。
items.body_en: A test using prompts containing unique, trackable secrets showed that user data does not stay private across the AI supply chain, with leakage at an 'alarming rate.' The research points to data-exposure risks at multiple points in training and inference pipelines.

items.title_en: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
items.body_zh: Intuit在2021年以约120亿美元收购Mailchimp，如今Bending Spoons以36.8亿美元接手，价格不到前者的三分之一。这笔交易延续了Bending Spoons低价收购成熟互联网产品的策略。
items.body_en: Intuit bought Mailchimp in 2021 for roughly $12 billion; Bending Spoons is now acquiring it for $3.68 billion, less than a third of that price. The deal extends Bending Spoons' strategy of buying mature internet products at a discount.

items.title_zh: 特朗普威胁对海外建AI数据中心的美企征「巨额税」
items.title_en: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on US firms building AI data centers abroad
items.body_zh: 特朗普在白宫表示，不会允许美国公司把数据中心建到国外，并称将施加「巨额税收」惩罚，但未给出政策细节。他还称团队中有人是第一次听说这一想法，政策落地形式尚待确认。
items.body_en: Trump said at the White House he would not allow US companies to build data centers abroad and threatened a 'tremendous tax' as punishment, but offered few policy details. He also said some on his team were hearing about the idea for the first time, leaving the policy's form uncertain.

items.title_zh: AI抛售拖累美股，标普500与道指进入回调区间
items.title_en: AI selloff drags Wall Street lower; S&P 500 and Dow enter correction
items.body_zh: AI相关股票遭集中抛售，美股三大指数显著收低，标普500和道琼斯工业平均指数均跌入回调区间。Anthropic股价下滑也被列为市场压力来源之一。
items.body_en: A sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks pushed US indexes sharply lower, with the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average both falling into correction territory. A slide in Anthropic shares was also cited as a source of market pressure.

items.title_zh: Meta因AI数据中心排放创新高，重新评估2030净零目标
items.title_en: Meta re-evaluates 2030 net-zero goal as AI data center emissions hit record
items.body_zh: Meta表示正在「重新评估」其2030年可持续发展目标，原因是AI数据中心带来的排放创下纪录。外界关注其他大型科技公司是否会跟进调整气候承诺。
items.body_en: Meta says it is 're-evaluating' its 2030 sustainability goals as emissions from AI data centers hit record levels. Attention now turns to whether other big tech companies will follow in adjusting their climate commitments.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯导弹落入波兰，北约称「严重侵犯」领空
items.title_en: Russian missiles land in Poland; NATO calls it a 'grave violation'
items.body_zh: 波兰总理图斯克称，一枚俄罗斯导弹落入波兰境内，事发时乌克兰盟友正在附近举行军演。无人受伤，也无损失报告，但华沙称这是莫斯科的「挑衅」，北约称之为对领空的「严重侵犯」。
items.body_en: Polish PM Donald Tusk said a Russian missile landed in Poland as Ukraine's allies held military drills nearby. No one was hurt and no damage was reported, but Warsaw called it a 'provocation' from Moscow and NATO described it as a 'grave violation' of airspace.

items.title_zh: GTA 6首日收入37.9亿美元，创娱乐业首发纪录
items.title_en: GTA VI earns $3.79 billion on day one, a record for any entertainment launch
items.body_zh: Rockstar母公司Take-Two宣布，《GTA 6》首发当日零售销售额达37.9亿美元，超过《复仇者联盟4》约29亿美元的全球累计票房。游戏预购量达3250万份，上线还带动了全球互联网流量和直播热潮。
items.body_en: Take-Two, Rockstar's parent, said GTA VI generated $3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day, surpassing the roughly $2.9 billion global box office of Avengers: Endgame. Preorders reached 32.5 million copies, and the launch drove a global surge in internet traffic and streaming.

quick_zh: YouTube据报准备以30亿美元和解「成瘾性设计」伤害儿童的集体诉讼，协议还包括针对青少年的新保护措施。
特朗普称希望乌克兰在明年1月前与俄罗斯达成和平协议，库什纳称俄方对类似北约的安全保障「感到舒适」。
劳伦·普莱斯击败科塔斯科娃，成为无可争议的世界次中量级拳王。
quick_en: YouTube is reportedly preparing a $3 billion settlement over claims its 'addictive design' harmed children, with new safeguards for teens included.
Trump is seeking a Ukraine peace deal before January, and Jared Kushner says Russia is 'comfortable' with NATO-like security guarantees for Kyiv.
Lauren Price beat Michaela Kotaskova to become the undisputed world welterweight champion.
